title: LIDAR-Guided Autonomous Alarm Clock
summary: An alarm clock that runs from you: a two-wheeled robot that uses LIDAR to scan the room and dodge obstacles while fleeing, forcing you out of bed to catch it.
bullets: Designed physical parts in SolidWorks and wired a dual-voltage battery system to power and drive the robot.
Set up and integrated LIDAR, motors, and an LCD display for real-time environmental scanning and control.
Programmed the onboard controller to interpret sensor data and make autonomous driving decisions.
Built and tested a functional prototype demonstrating reliable obstacle avoidance and mobility.

title: Magnetic Quick-Disconnect Air Coupler
summary: A magnetic quick-coupler solving recurring air-needle bending and breakage, enabling clean, rapid disconnects under pressure.
bullets: Designed a magnetic quick-coupler to prevent air needle damage during connect/disconnect cycles.
Oversaw precision manufacturing of components in the campus machine shop.
Validated the design through iterative prototyping, achieving reliable disconnects at pressures below 50 PSI.
